description: Listings of one LabX seller (lab equipment marketplace) from the seller's public profile page: listing id, title, price range, currency, condition, category, source link and availability date (about 20 per page), plus the seller's active-listing count. Prices are the seller's asking prices as listed; 'Request a Quote' listings have no price. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_x_com when you need One public X post by URL or ID from the JSON behind X's; social_x_com_profiles when you need Public X profiles for up to 10 usernames via the free. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

seller.description: LabX seller path: slug/id as in the profile URL, e.g. union-standard-equipment/51621
